nonClauseCategories.rule: A preference is not automatically Reference House identity or a deployment freedom.
An open question is not permission; unresolved authority remains unresolved.
Superseded geometry/history is provenance only and is not an admitted deployment variant.

entries.subject: G-01 architectural grammar
entries.claimBoundary: Grammar conformance is architectural-language authority, not a whole-site compatibility result.

entries.subject: Genuine open-to-sky courtyard house
entries.claimBoundary: Native candidate fact proves only preservation/loss of the controlled courtyard condition.

entries.subject: Compact detached contemporary family-house type
entries.claimBoundary: Project type/scale posture is architectural identity, not a statutory use-class or site-capacity rule.

entries.subject: Courtyard-centred arrival / garden sequence
entries.claimBoundary: Protects the architectural relation rather than a mandatory straight-line route.

entries.subject: Room-based and hierarchically legible architecture
entries.claimBoundary: Does not freeze every current internal partition coordinate.

entries.subject: Concentrated technical geography subordinate to principal rooms
entries.claimBoundary: Protects the selected spatial/technical integration without universalising the serviceability doctrine.

entries.subject: Coupled architectural order rather than applied façade styling
entries.claimBoundary: Protects plan/section/elevation coupling, not every opening dimension.

entries.subject: Principal gross geometry
entries.claimBoundary: Native facts cover the controlled shell/courtyard/storey geometry only.

entries.subject: Ground-floor topology
entries.claimBoundary: Protects selected relationships while provisional partition splits retain their source status.

entries.subject: Upper-floor topology
entries.claimBoundary: Four-bedroom active programme and selected circulation/service relationships are protected; historical five-bedroom latitude is not a route.

entries.subject: Principal stair topology
entries.claimBoundary: 300 mm going is a controlled Reference House choice, not a universal minimum.

entries.subject: Sectional hierarchy
entries.claimBoundary: Material visible hierarchy is protected; hidden technical thickness can remain implementation work where architecture survives.

entries.subject: Front architectural field
entries.claimBoundary: Native check covers four-bay field, spacing and ranked entrance including mirror-equivalent entrance under RH-V01.

entries.subject: Courtyard architectural orders
entries.claimBoundary: Differentiated courtyard relationships are protected while still-provisional opening products/sizes remain downstream.

entries.subject: Primary structural concept
entries.claimBoundary: Conformance protects the architectural structural concept; member/foundation adequacy remains competent engineering.

entries.subject: Envelope / opening life-separation concept
entries.claimBoundary: Protects architectural envelope/interface logic, not exact products or performance proof.

entries.subject: Concentrated service topology
entries.claimBoundary: Protects service geography/topology while exact route refinement remains implementation work.

entries.subject: Environmental hierarchy
entries.claimBoundary: Protects passive/environmental architectural hierarchy; detailed modelling remains external/future evidence.

entries.subject: Selected whole-house system geography
entries.claimBoundary: System-family geography is protected without claiming equipment performance or universal necessity.

entries.subject: Roof / water topology
entries.claimBoundary: Protects outward-draining roof/water architecture; hydraulic sizing remains technical design.

entries.subject: Maintenance geography remains an architectural requirement
entries.claimBoundary: Protected maintenance requirement is architectural; the real-site access solution is site-interface evidence.

entries.subject: Tectonic / visible-interface hierarchy
entries.claimBoundary: Protects tectonic posture while exact finish/joinery/metal choices remain downstream where not separately frozen.

entries.subject: Coherent whole-house left/right mirror
entries.claimBoundary: Admits a route only; downstream coherence and target/site adequacy remain separate.

entries.subject: Rigid site placement and cardinal orientation
entries.claimBoundary: Admits translation/rotation without internal deformation; site-role coherence remains downstream.

entries.subject: Foundation / ground support
entries.claimBoundary: Foundation response may vary only while protected load-path architecture survives.

entries.subject: Absolute datum and external level transition
entries.claimBoundary: Absolute elevation is site-conditioned; internal relative levels remain protected.

entries.subject: Utility approach outside protected internal geography
entries.claimBoundary: External approach can vary; protected internal service geography cannot be silently moved.

entries.subject: Foul and surface-water discharge beyond controlled building-side points
entries.claimBoundary: Destination/route is site-specific while protected building-side roof/water topology remains intact.

entries.subject: Principal approach / external access / landscape integration
entries.claimBoundary: Exact external path/landscape may vary while entrance, threshold, maintenance and replacement duties survive.

entries.subject: Site-specific solar / privacy / noise mitigation outside protected order
entries.claimBoundary: Mitigation may be authored only where protected opening/order and environmental duties survive.

entries.subject: Foundation engineering details
entries.claimBoundary: Engineering detail remains future/external unless it creates architectural consequences.

entries.subject: Structural sizing / connections / floor-edge resolution
entries.claimBoundary: Structural concept is protected; exact engineered details remain competent future work.

entries.subject: Wall-build-up product / detail choices
entries.claimBoundary: Product/detail variation is future work while protected envelope/geometry survives.

entries.subject: Window / door product within protected openings
entries.claimBoundary: Product choice may vary while protected opening host/order and full performance duties remain.

entries.subject: Exact plant / equipment products
entries.claimBoundary: Equipment may vary within selected system/space/replacement geography; performance proof remains future.

entries.subject: Exact service routing inside protected route classes
entries.claimBoundary: Detailed routing may refine only inside protected geography/structural/access rules.

entries.subject: Roof build-up and hydraulic sizing
entries.claimBoundary: Final roof products/falls/gutters/hydraulics remain technical design while RH-PROT-13 survives.

entries.subject: Detailed finishes / joinery / metalwork where not separately frozen
entries.claimBoundary: Detailed palette/craft choices remain downstream unless separately controlled.
